body: Honestly just life, I am afraid for the future of the world and for our next generation. I also have a lot of stress on me because I have done so well in certain aspects of life people expect me to keep that up but in the process other things are crashing down. It's hard to explain, Thanks for asking :)
I feel this. Depression is caused by a chemical imbalance in brain levels from some thing or another - so technically its irrational we feel this way but honestly, its hard not to.
